title: Blocked ERC20 tokens can still be withdrawn
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Some ERC20 tokens are expected to be blocked in the contract with the `onlyUnblockedTokens` modifier, and the owner shouldn't be able to withdraw them.
